error.portInUse: Port {port} is already used by another program. Close that program or change the port in settings.json.
settings.title: Now Playing widget settings
settings.appsHint: Browsers (Chrome and others) also pick up video and live-stream sound, so they start turned off. If you listen to YouTube Music, follow the steps below to turn on just YouTube Music.
settings.appsEmpty: No apps found yet. Play some music and it will show up here.
settings.saved: Saved. Your OBS widgets update right away.
settings.nothingPlaying: Nothing is playing, so the preview shows a sample track.
settings.autoColors: Change colors with each song (from album art)
settings.autoColorsHint: Songs without album art use the colors above. The big text style only changes the accent color.
settings.widgetUrlsHint: In OBS: Add Source → Browser → paste into the URL field, and set Width × Height to the size under each name. The widget connects by itself even if this app starts after OBS.
settings.ytmHowTo: Show only YouTube Music (without video or stream sound)
settings.ytmStep2: Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar (a monitor with a down arrow), then "Install". If you don't see it, open the ⋮ menu at the top right → Cast, save, and share → Install page as app.
settings.ytmStep3: Play a song in the new YouTube Music window. From now on, open it from the YouTube Music icon on your desktop or Start menu.
settings.ytmStep4: When "YouTube Music (Chrome app)" appears in this list, turn it on, leave "Chrome" off, and save.
